title: Elite Baal cult tied to the Epstein material

tellings.quote: because it's apparent that the some of the elite, some of our ruling elite are obsessed with with Bal.

plain: A guest named Tim Alberino, on Jesse Michels's podcast, says that some of today's ruling elite seem obsessed with Baal, an ancient Middle Eastern god. He ties this to the Epstein files, records connected to the wealthy financier Jeffrey Epstein, without naming a source for the link. If true, it would mean powerful people secretly hold to an old religious cult.
